sloka: भ्राता कथम् नाम महा गुणस्य भ्रातुर् वधम् राम विरोचयेत ।राजस्य दुःखस्य च वीर सारम् विचिन्तयन् काम पुरस्कृतो अपि ॥४-२४-९॥
transliteration: bhrātā katham nāma mahā guṇasya bhrātur vadham rāma virocayeta ।rājasya duḥkhasya ca vīra sāram vicintayan kāma puraskṛto api ॥4-24-9॥

translations.english: 'O Rama prompted by passion, without thinking of the difference between obtaining the kingdom to satisfy one's desire and the consequent grief, which brother would be willing to kill his virtuous elder brother?
